problem_text:
A logistics firm must dispatch a technician to perform maintenance checks at twelve different facilities scattered across a region. The travel durations between any two facilities, measured in minutes, are predetermined as follows:

* Facility Alpha to Bravo: 115.0 minutes
* Alpha to Charlie: 84.9 minutes
* Alpha to Delta: 63.2 minutes
* Alpha to Echo: 103.2 minutes
* Alpha to Foxtrot: 141.3 minutes
* Alpha to Golf: 28.1 minutes
* Alpha to Hotel: 71.3 minutes
* Alpha to India: 119.0 minutes
* Alpha to Juliet: 65.8 minutes
* Alpha to Kilo: 101.2 minutes
* Alpha to Lima: 79.5 minutes
* Bravo to Charlie: 100.1 minutes
* Bravo to Delta: 132.0 minutes
* Bravo to Echo: 42.6 minutes
* Bravo to Foxtrot: 121.1 minutes
* Bravo to Golf: 141.7 minutes
* Bravo to Hotel: 186.0 minutes
* Bravo to India: 28.2 minutes
* Bravo to Juliet: 166.2 minutes
* Bravo to Kilo: 164.5 minutes
* Bravo to Lima: 169.9 minutes
* Charlie to Delta: 142.6 minutes
* Charlie to Echo: 60.8 minutes

* Charlie to Hotel: 141.3 minutes
* Charlie to India: 82.7 minutes

* Charlie to Lima: 164.3 minutes
* Delta to Echo: 140.1 minutes

* Echo to Lima: 173.1 minutes
* Foxtrot to Golf: 165.1 minutes
* Foxtrot to Hotel: 185.5 minutes
* Foxtrot to India: 148.5 minutes
* Foxtrot to Juliet: 206.8 minutes
* Foxtrot to Kilo: 236.5 minutes
* Foxtrot to Lima: 130.1 minutes
* Golf to Hotel: 48.1 minutes

* Golf to Juliet: 43.2 minutes
* Golf to Kilo: 91.1 minutes

* Hotel to India: 190.1 minutes

* Hotel to Kilo: 122.1 minutes
* Hotel to Lima: 66.8 minutes
* India to Juliet: 160.7 minutes
* India to Kilo: 149.5 minutes
* India to Lima: 183.6 minutes
* Juliet to Kilo: 58.2 minutes
* Juliet to Lima: 117.6 minutes
* Kilo to Lima: 170.3 minutes

The objective is to determine the sequence for the technician's tour that minimizes the total travel time, under the condition that each facility is visited precisely one time before the technician returns to the initial departure point.
